integrity: Analytical proof and finite numerical reproducibility checks; parameter-dependent crossover is not an observed epidemiological effect. Earlier reinfection thresholds and generic critical slowing are acknowledged. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact threshold R0*phi=1; positive initial infected and never-infected stratum masses; phi in (0,1), theta in [phi,1]; deterministic well-mixed closed six-compartment SIRI, no demographic turnover, finite-population extinction or noncritical claims.
title: An exponentially delayed vaccine-susceptibility crossover at the critical reinfection threshold
